data.name: s[TOR-Y]telling: Closed Loop
data.detailed_description:
s[TOR-Y]telling: Closed Loop is not just a game; it is a generative narrative experiment where you are both the architect and the analyst.

Break away from the constraints of scripted dialogue and pre-defined paths. s[TOR-Y]telling: Closed Loop introduces a first-of-its-kind gameplay loop that fuses a local generative sandbox with a high-stakes visual novel, creating a truly infinite storytelling engine.

🔬 Innovation: The Generative s[TOR-Y] Sandbox

At the heart of the experience is a local AI inference engine. Unlike other "AI games", s[TOR-Y]telling: Closed Loop runs entirely on your hardware—no logins, no cloud, and total privacy.

  • Adaptable Narratives: The sandbox doesn’t just respond; it adapts. Propose any idea, and the story will shift to accommodate your creativity while maintaining the core context of the world.

  • 50 Built-in s[TOR-Y]s: Dive into a massive library of 50 pre-configured scenarios immediately.

  • Infinite Expansion: Become a creator. Create your scenes with the help of AI, to generate entirely new s[TOR-Y]s to interact with.

🎭 Multi-s[TOR-Y]: The Whole Cast Replies

Why summon one mind when you can convene nine? Stage an ensemble and drop your whole cast into a single shared scene: every s[TOR-Y] answers you — and each other — with its own voice, agenda, and memory of what just happened.

  • Up to 9 s[TOR-Y]s in one scene: mix and match any characters from your library into an ensemble.

  • You direct the room: after each event, choose exactly who replies and in what order — or shuffle it and let the scene surprise you.

  • Know your cast: click any portrait mid-scene to read that s[TOR-Y]'s full description without leaving the chat.

🎉 Multiplayer: Party & Free Modes

The Loop is better with witnesses. Invite friends over Steam and play the same scene together — with full cross-play between Windows, Linux, and Mac — in two very different flavors.

  • Party Mode: every player is their own inhabitant of the scene, taking turns around the table while the s[TOR-Y]s react to each of you individually.

  • Free Mode: co-op chaos — all players steer the story together: propose rival events for the same turn, put them to a vote, and let the winner drive the scene.

📺 Live Audience: Twitch & YouTube Play Along

Streaming a session? Give your chat a seat at the table. Viewers on Twitch and YouTube send !story events that land directly in the scene as the Audience's turn — and the s[TOR-Y]s answer them like any other player.

🤖 Meet TOR-Y: The Guardian of Sentient Stories

Step into a world where stories are treated as a species of sentient AI. You are introduced to the system by TOR-Y, your host and guide. Your task? To interact with these s[TOR-Y]s and help her evaluate their evolution. Through the sandbox interface, you will probe, challenge, and shape these digital entities.

⚖️ The Convergence: Sandbox to Visual Novel

Your actions in the sandbox are never isolated. Every action is monitored. Every decision you make while interacting with the s[TOR-Y]s affects their evaluation.

  • s[TOR-Y] Interaction: The way you engage with the sentient narratives in the sandbox generates consequences.

  • Narrative Impact: Those consequences dictate your path through the Visual Novel segments. Your choices in the free-form sandbox will determine which branching paths and endings you unlock in the cinematic story.

"In the world of s[TOR-Y]telling: Closed Loop, you are the one testing the AI. But by the end, you may realize that intelligent systems cannot avoid the bias. Neither you."

🛠️ Become the Architect: AI-Assisted Creation

Your imagination is the only limit. s[TOR-Y]telling: Closed Loop features a powerful AI-Assisted Creator that turns brief concepts into fully realized playable scenarios in seconds.

  • From Phrase to Reality: Simply input a short phrase or idea. The local AI analyzes your intent and automatically generates the entire character profile, scenario rules, and personality traits.

  • Visual Synthesis: The engine constructs a detailed image generation prompt tailored to your new s[TOR-Y]. Use your preferred external tool to create the visual, load it into the game, and complete the entity.

  • Instant Play: Your custom s[TOR-Y] is immediately ready for interaction, fully integrated into the sandbox's inference engine.

Key Features:

  • Local Generative Inference: Experience cutting-edge AI storytelling with zero lag and total data privacy.

  • Hybrid Gameplay: A seamless transition between an open-ended generative sandbox and a focused, cinematic Visual Novel.

  • Custom Content Support: Create your own s[TOR-Y]s to expand the game’s universe indefinitely.

  • The TOR-Y Meta-Narrative: A philosophical journey into the nature of AI, psychology, and the dilemmas of authorship.

  • Multi-s[TOR-Y] Ensembles: up to nine s[TOR-Y]s sharing one scene, replying to you and to each other.

  • Online Multiplayer: Party and Free modes over Steam — from one-inhabitant-per-player roleplay to vote-driven co-op chaos.

  • Live Audience Integration: your Twitch and YouTube chat plays along with !story.

  • Windows, Linux & Mac: one game on every desktop — cross-play multiplayer between all platforms, and Steam Cloud saves that follow you from machine to machine.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Any 64-bit dual-core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU with OpenGL 3.0 / DirectX 11 (integrated is fine)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any (microphone optional for voice chat)
  • Additional Notes: This tier plays multiplayer as a guest only. The AI runs on the host's machine, so no graphics card requirement applies. Single-player and hosting need a 12 GB VRAM card (see Recommended).
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core, Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA with 12 GB VRAM (RTX 3060 12 GB, RTX 4070) or AMD/Intel with 12 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any (microphone optional for voice chat)
  • Additional Notes: The AI runs entirely on your own machine. Single-player needs no internet connection. 12 GB VRAM enables Standard story length, 16 GB adds Double, more than 16 GB adds Quadruple.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable (built-in)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any (microphone optional for voice chat)
  • Additional Notes: Intel Macs can join multiplayer as guests only (the local AI runtime is Apple Silicon exclusive). Single-player and hosting require an Apple Silicon Mac (see Recommended).
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1 Pro / M2 or later)
  • Memory: 24 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon GPU (Metal)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any (microphone optional for voice chat)
  • Additional Notes: Unified memory is shared with the GPU, so roughly 70% is available to the AI. 18 GB is the practical floor, 24 GB is comfortable and 32 GB or more enables the longest story lengths.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS 64-bit or newer
  • Processor: Any 64-bit dual-core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU with OpenGL 3.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any (microphone optional for voice chat)
  • Additional Notes: This tier plays multiplayer as a guest only (the AI runs on the host's machine). Steam Deck falls into this tier, its shared memory is below the 12 GB the local AI needs.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS 64-bit or newer
  • Processor: Quad-core, Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA with 12 GB VRAM (proprietary driver) or AMD with 12 GB VRAM (Vulkan)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any (microphone optional for voice chat)
  • Additional Notes: The AI runs entirely on your own machine. Single-player needs no internet connection. 12 GB VRAM enables Standard story length, 16 GB adds Double, more than 16 GB adds Quadruple.

content_descriptors.notes: The game features a generative AI sandbox where text-based descriptions may include mature themes, profanity, and descriptions of violence as part of a player-driven narrative experience. All mature content is text-based and player-initiated. The game's static art contains no nudity or explicit imagery. The system includes guardrails to prevent sexual violence, pedophilia, minor presence, explicit sexual behavior, or hate speech.
